I'd say it's all relative. If you're upgrading from a 1080 ti to this, you're functionally wasting money. The RTX line feels incremental compared to the older GTX lineup, which makes upgrading at this point in time a bit of a dicey proposition, value-wise. I did that exact switch for different reasons, however, seeing as I needed to change my motherboard and CPU and was starting to feel the need to experiment with the ITX form-factor. It's still an interesting choice if curiosity is what's motivating your choice.

If you've got a 750 or a 950 Ti, however, then going for a Super makes complete sense. It's not a Strix OC or its equivalent for Zotac or the other manufacturers, but it's still got a decent boost clock. A 17% increase compared to the core RTX 2080 might seem frivolous - and it mostly is, considering the price difference - but it still adds that much more comfort and responsiveness.
